Descriptive state comparison cannot isolate treatment-induced change or establish target efficacy.

resources.name: Chakrabarti 2018 HCT116 cisplatin full-lineage event workbook and codebook
resources.record_grain: Repeated lineage histories in four 394 by 243 arrays; candidate cell/parent graph reconstructed with unresolved observation and identifier assumptions
resources.units: Nominal 30-minute frames, binary division and apoptosis annotations, p53 fluorescence, frame-specific lineage labels
join_keys: changing lineage label; parent mapping requires structural reconstruction
resources.access: Public article-associated materials under CC BY 4.0, subject to separately credited exceptions; attribution and transformation details required. Original workbook/codebook retained locally; only authored audit and source links published.
resources.limitations: Colorectal cell line, not Iowa patients or EGFR lung cancer. Source says 49 hours/frame 98 before treatment versus 50 hours in methods. No replicate/field identifiers in arrays. Iyer reports 83 ancestor trees and 18 exclusions including 13 never-dividers; these source-reported counts and exclusions are not an independent structural reconstruction or outcome-independent eligibility rule. Structural audit finds incomplete daughter observations. Published exclusion identifiers are not verified joins to dynamic source labels. Apparently complete later subtrees are selected using future recording information; no naive whole-cohort horizon test is certified.

resources.name: Kuchen 2020 TET21N neuroblastoma sister-pair lineage source workbooks
resources.record_grain: 4,678 exported sister-pair rows / 9,356 child records in seven sheets; not a certified original-founder denominator
resources.units: Birth and division/death/loss durations in hours; opaque cell/mother/lineage IDs; control birth coordinates in source units
resources.access: Source links and article CC BY 4.0 attribution verified. Established cell-line data, no human participant records. Raw originals retained locally; public findings, hashes and parser provided.
resources.limitations: First exported generation is 2; future-independent inclusion and loss meanings remain uncertified. Four negative loss durations and one division without successor pair remain unknown. Rapamycin dose-to-sheet mapping conflicts with duration/generation overview. Biological versus technical replication is unspecified. Growth/cycle perturbations do not define a drug-persister cohort. No Q, covariance or treatment association fitted.
